title.english: Ascendance of a Bookworm: Adopted Daughter of an Archduke
title.native: 本好きの下剋上 領主の養女

synonyms: 本好きの下剋上 司書になるためには手段を選んでいられません 第4期
Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen 4th Season
description:
Following a disastrous encounter with a noble, Myne finally resolves to say goodbye to her family and friends in the lower city, changing her name to “Rozemyne” and beginning her new life as the adopted daughter of Ehrenfest’s archduke. However, her days as an archnoble in noble society are brutal, as she is put through rigorous etiquette and magic training on top of her duties as High Bishop and forewoman. It all proves too much for a weak little seven-year-old girl... Or it would have, had the High Priest not offered her the keys to the temple’s book room as a reward. If she could get her hands on those, she’d be able to read all sorts of precious books! Her name may have changed, but Rozemyne’s passion for books remains the same as she charges into a whole new world! The detailed setting expands as the printing industry grows in size. Here begins Part 3 of this biblio-fantasy for book lovers everywhere!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Rozemyne is an archnoble girl. Her flowing midnight-blue hair is well kept, silkier than even the hair of most archnoble girls, and her moon-like golden-yellow eyes are like windows into her emotional heart. She has a pretty face as well, and would no doubt grow up to be a true beauty. She has pale white skin largely untouched by the sun, and soft hands that weren't at all worn down by labor. Rozemyne ​​has a massive amount of mana inside her. Her mana is so great that Karstedt determined that it was necessary to hide his own daughter and raise her in secret, away from any danger. [The former High Bishop](https://anilist.co/character/126545) misunderstood her presence in the temple, and not discerning her true identity, he began to groan and complain that a commoner shrine maiden disturbed the peace. Rozemyne ​​was raised humbly, unaware of her parents or their status, but still, her compassionate heart ached for the suffering of those who lived in worse circumstances than her. She felt sorry for the children who lived in the orphanage, and did what no one else would by giving them food and work, due to that, Rozemyne is worshiped and honored by the orphans as a Saint. [The Archduke](https://anilist.co/character/157135) determined that the work Rozemyne gave to the orphans could become a new industry for his duchy. Just when he was considering spending the next twenty or more years spreading it around the duchy, Rozemyne ​​was targeted by [a noble from another duchy](https://anilist.co/character/157148). In order to secure Rozemyne's position in the nobility, and to protect her mana wealth for the sake of Ehrenfest, the Archduke adopted her.!~

He is a blue priest who serves as the High Priest of the temple of the city of Ehrenfest. He is tall and slender, he has light blue hair that reaches down towards his shoulders and pale golden eyes. People frequently mistake him by being older than he really is. ~!He was the son of a concubine in noble society. Regardless of [his father’s true wife](https://anilist.co/character/194299), his relationship with his older half-brother was not at all bad. After his father's death, his half-brother recommended him to join the temple. Before he became the High Priest, with the help of his half-brother he built a library inside the temple, one that even nobles with unfortunate economic circumstances would be able to use. Despite the fact that it had not been terribly long since he joined the temple and that he was still very young, he became the High Priest due to all of the people who were primarily in charge of managing the temple’s affairs had been called away to noble society, leaving him to take on every single aspect of running the temple.!~
